senses.gloss:
Arka, as the name of the tree Colotropis gigantea, is perhaps found in one obscure passage of the Atharvaveda.
Foot notes vi. 72, 1, where see Whitney's note. Cf. St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
Arka (Calotropis gigantea) is often referred to in the Satapatha brāhmaṇa (ix. 1, 1, 4. 9; its leaf: arka-parṇa, 42; arkapalāśa, i. 2, 3, 12. 13).
Ārkṣa.--Patronymic of Śrutarvan and of Āśvamedha.
